description: This is a test source file for the AmqpPublisherActor class, containing unit tests that verify messaging functionality with AMQP in the context of the Eclipse Ditto project, including message publishing, handling full queues, reconnection logic, and message properties.

classes.name: AmqpPublisherActorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the behavior of the AmqpPublisherActor, including message publishing, queue handling, backoff/recovery, and message property setting within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: setupMocks
methods.description: Sets up Mockito mocks for JMS session and producer.

methods.name: testMsgPublishedOntoFullQueueShallBeDropped
methods.description: Tests that when the queue is full, messages are dropped and acknowledged as such.

methods.name: newMultiMappedThingDeleted
methods.description: Creates a new OutboundSignal of ThingDeleted type with specific headers and target.

methods.name: testRecoverPublisher
methods.description: Verifies that the publisher recovers after failures and re-establishes the producer.

methods.name: producerClosedDuringBackOffIsIgnored
methods.description: Ensures that producer closure events during backoff are ignored without redundant producer creation.

methods.name: testPublishMessageWithAmqpProperties
methods.description: Checks that messages are correctly populated with AMQP properties and application properties.

methods.name: getPublisherActorProps
methods.description: Provides the Props configuration for creating an AmqpPublisherActor instance.

methods.name: verifyAcknowledgements
methods.description: Verifies that message acknowledgements are correctly sent and processed.

methods.name: verifyPublishedMessage
methods.description: Checks that a message was published with expected properties.

methods.name: verifyPublishedMessageToReplyTarget
methods.description: Verifies published message headers for reply target messaging.

methods.name: decorateTarget
methods.description: Returns the target, potentially decorated or modified.
